images.prompt: Vintage grainy 35mm film still, flat overhead fluorescent tubes, cold gray-teal concrete. A long queue of plague-marked people in a bare concrete relief hall: visibly altered skin, mottled lesions and subtly wrong proportions, salvaged mismatched clothing, blankets over shoulders, dented water buckets, a hand-painted wooden number board on the wall. Exhausted, patient, enduring rather than dying. 35mm, static locked-off, heavy grain, no text, no logos, no gore.

Vintage grainy 35mm film still, dusk, cold desaturated gray-teal with a thin amber horizon. Foreground: a salvage settlement built into cracked concrete freeway ruins — hand-built tools, water drums, laundry lines, a chugging generator wired to strings of fluorescent tubes, stacked CRT monitors, people in worn scavenged gear. Background across a dust plain: the distant sealed glass arcology towers glowing warm and untouchable behind their perimeter lights. Extreme wide 24mm, deep focus, heavy grain, dust haze, no text, no logos.

Vintage 1970s documentary film still, heavy 35mm grain, halation, desaturated cold gray-teal palette. Wide establishing shot of a single mirrored corporate glass tower under construction rising above a dying farm valley: cracked soil, dead irrigation pipes, a rusted grain silo in the foreground, bare shelterbelt trees. Overcast dust haze, weak low sun. 24mm deep focus, static locked-off camera. Bleak, unglamorous, no text, no logos, no stylization.

Vintage grainy 35mm film still, night, desaturated gray-teal with a single red flare. A wide industrial outflow pipe pours pale viscous sludge into a slow rural river; dead fish scattered along the mudbank; the small lights of a rural American farm town on the far bank; an unmarked tanker truck idling on the levee with headlights cutting through mist. Wide 28mm, low angle from the waterline, heavy grain, practical haze, no text, no logos.

Vintage grainy 35mm film still, pale dawn, desaturated sickly gray-green cast. A crowded low-rise city district at first light seen from a rooftop: a fine pale aerosol haze drifting down from industrial ventilation stacks, settling over the streets; commuters and market stalls below, unaware; a sealed unmarked service truck parked by the vent housing; birds scattered dead on the roof gravel. Wide 28mm, high angle, heavy grain, practical haze, no text, no logos.

Vintage grainy 35mm film still, warm amber interior against a cold gray world beyond the glass. A private clinical suite high inside a corporate tower: wealthy patients in pale gowns reclined in amber-lit treatment chairs, clear IV lines, a gloved technician preparing a syringe from a rack of amber vials, polished concrete floor, floor-to-ceiling glass showing dust haze and a dying city far below. 50mm, slow deliberate composition, heavy grain, no text, no logos.

Vintage grainy 35mm film still, clinical white and cold gray-teal, flat overhead fluorescent light. Interior of a vast sterile corporate biological research floor seen through thick scratched observation glass: rows of sealed incubators, glass culture vessels, CRT-era terminals, cable trunking, technicians in white pressure suits moving between racks. Amber warning lamps on the far wall. 35mm, symmetrical composition, heavy grain, haze, no text, no logos, documentary realism.

Vintage grainy 35mm film still, cold desaturated gray-teal, dust haze. Enormous brutalist glass-and-steel arcology monoliths rising from a husked-out dust plain on massive concrete plinths, sealed skybridges between them, construction cranes, a fenced and floodlit perimeter, and a sprawl of tiny improvised shanty shelters clustered at the base far below. Extreme wide shot, 24mm, low horizon, heavy grain, no lens flare, no text, no logos.

Vintage grainy 35mm film still, bleached desaturated daylight, dust in the air. Abandoned rural American main street: empty storefronts, plastic quarantine sheeting stapled over doorways, faded hazard notices, two children's bicycles lying on their sides in the road, a collapsed field hospital tent at the intersection, no people at all. Wide 24mm, static locked-off, heavy grain, overcast flat light, no text, no logos, quiet and dead.

Vintage grainy 35mm film still, pale dawn, desaturated sickly gray-green cast. A crowded low-rise city district at first light seen from a rooftop: a fine pale aerosol haze drifting down from industrial ventilation stacks, settling over the streets; commuters and market stalls below, unaware; birds scattered dead on the roof gravel. Wide 28mm, high angle, heavy grain, practical haze, no text, no logos.

Same man as the reference images — identical face, wearing the matte black tactical bodysuit with segmented shoulder and forearm plating, two leaf-bladed throwing knives crossed in an X across the sternum, four syringe barrels on the left forearm gauntlet, clear feed line at the right wrist, black gloves and boots. Walking directly toward camera down a long narrow raw concrete corridor lit by failing fluorescent tubes. Narrow vertical contained silhouette, too thin to look dangerous. Wide 28mm, low camera, cold desaturated gray-teal, heavy film grain, haze, cinematic, no text.

Same man as the reference images — identical face and build. Close three-quarter shot of him seating a matte black forearm gauntlet over the shunt port, clear surgical tubing running from his wrist into a manifold feeding four exposed syringe barrels. Machined titanium, medical stainless fittings, no chrome, no gloss. Workbench behind him with two leaf-bladed hollow-channel throwing knives laid out on cloth. Amber work lamp key light, deep black surroundings. 50mm shallow focus, heavy film grain, desaturated, cinematic, no text.

Same man as the reference images — identical face, gaunt hollow cheeks, pale gray-blue eyes, dark buzzcut, lean sinewy build, heavy scarring on the right forearm. Seated alone on a metal stool in a bare concrete bunker room, white ribbed tank top, dark work trousers, worn boots, cigarette burning down between his fingers, staring at nothing. Clinical white walls, single caged fluorescent tube overhead, flat unflattering light. 85mm, static locked-off, symmetrical, desaturated cold gray, heavy 35mm film grain, cinematic, no stylization, no text.

Same man as the reference images — identical face, in full matte black tactical field kit with crossed throwing knives and forearm syringe gauntlet. Standing small and still on a ridge of cracked dust plain at dusk, back three-quarters to camera, looking down at a floodlit corporate compound perimeter far below. Salvage-era wasteland, dead scrub, wind-blown dust. Extreme wide 24mm, subject small in frame, cold desaturated gray-teal with a thin dying amber horizon, heavy film grain, no lens flare, cinematic, no text.

Same man as the reference images, but losing himself — containment failure, not a power-up. The matte black tactical suit is splitting apart: seams tearing, shoulder plating lifting away, straps snapped. Skin stretched taut and bloodless, thick blackened veins bulging and pulsing across neck and arms, eyes fully consumed by sickly luminous green with no iris and no pupil, jaw distended past the limit of the skull. Anatomically wrong proportions — shoulders sitting too high, one arm too long, an extra joint, improvised and asymmetrical, never a heroic bodybuilder shape. Sickly green self-illumination spilling onto the concrete walls and floor. Low angle, unstable wide 20mm, heavy film grain, cinematic, horrifying, not triumphant, no text.

Extreme macro on a deep open wound across a pale scarred human forearm that is not bleeding at all. The surrounding tissue has been visibly pulled inward toward the wound, puckered like drying acrylic skin, and the opening is sealed beneath a thick glossy lacquered black plate — obsidian-like, cracked at the flex points, a faint sickly green sheen where raking light catches it. Spent brass and a dropped scalpel on the concrete beneath. 100mm macro, hard raking practical light, cold gray-teal surroundings, heavy film grain, cinematic, no text.

Same man as the reference images, human again and hollowed out — skeletal, emaciated, skin loose where his own reserves were stripped away, cheeks sunken to the skull. Kneeling alone on the concrete floor of a wrecked corridor amid the torn shreds of his black tactical suit, staring down at his own open hands like they belong to someone else. Bent metal, scattered debris, thin smoke. Dim red emergency light, wide empty frame, subject small and isolated in the composition. Static locked-off 24mm, desaturated, heavy 35mm film grain, cinematic, quiet and defeated, no text.

Same man as the reference images — identical face, cold and evaluating, entirely without expression. Standing perfectly still in a dim concrete service corridor in full matte black tactical field kit, a hollow-channel leaf blade held low at his side, already finished. Two corporate security guards slumped unconscious against the wall behind him, rifles fallen, no visible injuries. Smoke and dust hanging in the air. Hard practical light from a broken wall fixture. 35mm, static, cold desaturated gray-teal, heavy film grain, cinematic, restrained, no text, no blood.
